svg.title: Who bears the costs of a recovery plan?
svg.desc: A worker: Employment and the journey to work both matter.. A public authority: Spending choices influence infrastructure for many years.. Between countries: Historic emissions and present resources are unequally distributed.

g.text: Who bears the costs of a recovery plan?
Employment and the journey to work both matter.
Spending choices influence infrastructure for many years.
Historic emissions and present resources are unequally distributed.
